_about: Libram, White Fest (131146, blade_dancer_wt23): translated from the game's Japanese. Global names/terms: Libram, the House of Swes, Azrail, Ziggurat, Varen, Yuwel, Razelt, Nova, Reylas, Dul Kugala, Shota (Shou), the Farlands, Palpebra, White Fest, Valentine's Fest, Purgers, the House of Oinas. リーやん (Shou's nickname for him) = "Libby". Own romanizations: Grace, Yuni (the wine), Princess Iseria.
profile: Handsome, rich, and well-born. And yet his friends all say the same thing: "He's an adorable wimp. So no matter how nice a suit he puts on, there's no way Libby could ever gracefully escort a lady--" Wait, Libby?
titleCondition: Level Libram to 100 and obtain his Amity Scroll

speech.home/iisutsudaro: Fine suit, isn't it? Custom-made for White Fest! As for how much it cost... well... A necessary expense. It couldn't be helped! Yes!
speech.home/kiitazo: I heard, you two... You went to eat crêpes without me...! That's not fair! No matter how busy I look, you could at least try inviting me!
speech.home/shibuyawa: Shibuya is a fascinating place. Once its infrastructure is in order, not just daily life but its culture should flourish too... I should start considering tourism as well...!
speech.home/e_iya_soryaa: Huh. W-well, sure, I got a lot of chocolate, but that's only because they like my face and my status-- N-no? They like what's inside, too...? ...Wh... I mean... I-is that so...!?
speech.home/tomoniari: To coexist, and to prosper together. To use failure as fuel and keep moving forward... To make that beauty a reality, I'll do everything I can today too. With all of you, of course!
speech.home/shiro_nomini: Nimbus! Let's go drinking! Reylas told me about a nice bar, so the three of us... Y-you won't come!? Why!? Because we're all too handsome!?
speech.ally/join: Impressive. Admirable. Handsome. And the suit suits me well, too! You can do it, me. Go get 'em, me! Let's live up to everyone's expectations!
speech.ally/evolution: It's our time together, after all. I'd better bring my best. --Now, your hand, if you please. Just for now, won't you be mine?

1.title: The Man Who Escorts
1.summary: To deepen ties with Palpebra, Libram tours White Fest with Grace, a businesswoman. Libram lights a fire under Grace, who had resigned herself to her circumstances, and the two become friends on equal footing. But a few days later, a summons from Dul Kugala leaves him trembling in fear.

lines.6: Yes! This is a business opportunity! Do you understand!? Alk, Shota...!
lines.10: White Fest, an event unique to Palpebra! It's my chance to market the Farlands' finest sweets!
lines.13: Connecting the confectionery industry and strengthening our pipeline to Palpebra! Isn't that a vital mission only I of the House of Swes can carry out?
lines.17: Wow, he's really in his element... As long as he's having fun, I guess.
lines.21: No, like, wait. You're working again? Libby, didn't you say you had no free time during Valentine's Fest too?
lines.31: S-sorry, Shota...! But now's exactly the time I need to expand my connections...!
lines.34: Tomorrow I'm meeting with a renowned businesswoman of Palpebra, too. We plan to tour White Fest together!
lines.42: You mean a date, right...? No way...? I heard about you, man... That you've never once succeeded at picking someone up...
lines.46: Hmph, that's not it, Shota. Mere flirting and escorting are not one and the same.
lines.50: Escorting means respecting and honoring the other person, and bringing things to a relationship of equals-- Yes! It's a fine art of negotiation!
lines.54: Look forward to it, everyone! I'll make this negotiation a success! Thanks for the meal! Hahahaha...!!
lines.58: Today's the day, right? Libby's date. ......Aren't you curious?
lines.63: ..................I am curious. But no. That's being way too nosy. It's still work, after all--
lines.67: --Now, your hand, if you please. We wouldn't want to get separated.
lines.71: ...You're awfully kind. Are you used to women?
lines.73: You're the first to make my heart race this much, my lady.
lines.75: I have no intention of lying or flattering you. I want us to be equals.
lines.78: ...What a stuffy pickup line. Equals? That's nothing but a lie--
lines.81: I want to hold this hand because it's yours.
lines.83: Won't you at least believe that much?
lines.93: Drop the formalities. ...We're supposed to be equals, aren't we?
lines.96: Heh... Yes, you're right! There's a sweets shop up ahead we're working on a partnership with. Let's go.
lines.100: ...Th-that was... Libram, right? Not an impostor...?
lines.106: ...Why, man! I believed in him... I believed he was one of us, all looks and nothing else...!
lines.110: Ugh... I hate that I kind of agree...
lines.113: --...Today wasn't bad. When was the last time I walked through town this relaxed...?
lines.115: I'm glad to hear it. I'll have to thank these pancakes.
lines.118: You're... a good person. Wise and honest. You showed me exactly what's good about the Farlands, and you value what's good about Palpebra too.
lines.121: Those are kind words. I think the same of you--
lines.123: That's exactly why I'll tell you. Getting on my good side won't do you any good.
lines.125: Say. That ideal you told me about earlier...
lines.128: ...Maximizing mutual profit through competition. That "coexistence and co-prosperity" is the most beautiful form of business--
lines.130: But I'm only propped up by my family name and my looks. ...I don't even have the right to choose what to invest in, like you do.
lines.133: ...What you said is idealism. There's nothing I can--
lines.136: But that's what you want to choose, isn't it? Grace.
lines.140: You see good things and good people and want to invest in them. You listen to talk of coexistence and co-prosperity, and you yearn for that ideal--
lines.143: You're just like me. A merchant to a laughable degree!
lines.146: ...What's this all of a sudden... And your attitude is different from--
lines.149: Hmph. After all, I'm a third son nobody expects much from either! And I'm too powerless to even take you under my wing!
lines.153: But you know what? There are plenty of ways. And when it comes to judging people and making connections, I'm more confident than you!
lines.160: To make the ideals we hold come true-- Let's rely on everything we can!
lines.163: ...I don't dislike you as you are now. Even if you're not very cool.
lines.166: I know that full well! Better than anyone!!
lines.169: Heh... Now I see why Ms. Kugala keeps an eye on you. You got me...
lines.171: You've talked me into it. As friends, let's seize a good opportunity, shall we?
lines.175: ...Yes...! Of course! We'll make it a success--
lines.186: A-Alk!! Tell me!! What in the world am I supposed to do!!?
lines.195: It's Dul Kugala! I got word she's summoning me!
lines.198: Y-you see, the woman I befriended the other day is apparently close with Dul Kugala.
lines.201: And it seems she was sizing me up at Dul Kugala's request...! And the message I got says--
lines.205: I would like to have a thorough talk with you about future trade with the Farlands. Please regard it as a matter of importance.
lines.209: Let us hide nothing from each other. I hope we can speak frankly.
lines.214: That's exactly the tone of someone about to scold me!! Why!!?
lines.217: Ah, um... No. I think she actually likes you--
lines.222: Please, Alk! Come with me! You're on good terms with Dul Kugala, aren't you!? If you're there, I feel like I won't get scolded!!
lines.225: That's what scares you!? You were so cool and collected the other day!!
lines.230: That was that, this is this! I have connections and an eye for people, but I'm completely out of nerve!!?
lines.234: Wh-what on earth did I do wrong!? I didn't bring up money first this time!!? Aaahh, what do I dooo...!!
lines.238: Feels like the old Libby's back.
lines.247: Hey! Are you listening!? You two!!?

2.title: The Man of Principle
2.summary: While racking his brain with Nova and the others over White Fest return gifts, the conversation turns to romance. Libram declares that juggling work and love is impossible for him, but when he learns that a long-awaited deal with Starview Village may finally begin, he looks happier than ever.

lines.5: Then how about this!? A new sweet packed with everything girls love-- The Canelé Tapioca Maritozzo Crêpe!
lines.9: Rejected. Absurd. That's the idea of a three-year-old.
lines.14: Wh-why!? It's the result of listening to the people!!?
lines.18: Ahaha. I'd like to try it, though. Doesn't it sound fun?
lines.23: Hmm... It might go over well with men, but that's not the point right now--
lines.29: Oh, Alk and Shota! Let me hear your opinions too!
lines.32: What's up? Work stuff again? Like sweets that'll sell, or...?
lines.36: That topic is tempting too, but we're headed in a different direction right now.
lines.39: I'm currently agonizing over something. --My "White Day" gifts for the ladies!
lines.48: Oh, the return gifts for what I got at Valentine's Fest are no problem. I got about the same amount last year too!
lines.52: But this year, believe it or not! I got chocolate from the ladies of Shibuya too! Ah, being this handsome is such a burden!
lines.55: On top of that, in Shibuya you pay back three times as much on White Day, right? I have no choice but to go all out!
lines.59: So I wanted to hear from you two, since you're from Shibuya!
lines.62: Oh, don't worry. Money is one thing I have plenty of! Don't mind the price and give me your honest--
lines.68: Aah!! What are you doing! My honey cheese tart!
lines.72: Shut uuuup. What is this? Bragging? So not forgivable???
lines.77: Wh-why!? If you're cold to me, I'll cry!? Should I apologize for being too handsome!?
lines.81: Come on, you said you were busy with work, but you were wrapped up in romance this whole time?
lines.85: Th-that's not it, Shota! This is a perfectly legitimate part of work!
lines.88: Building connections and market research! Studying what sweets Shibuya's women want, to plan our future market expansion--!
lines.92: But you are aware that you're popular, aren't you?
lines.96: W-well... I'm happy about their feelings. Even if I know they only see my face and status and have the wrong idea!
lines.101: I can't tell if his self-esteem is high or low...
lines.104: Then why not try dating someone, work aside? You don't seem to mind it.
lines.110: Well... no... hmmm... That's, how should I put it... They're certainly all lovely and charming, but~
lines.115: I see? Right. You do think they're charming? And then, and then???
lines.129: Once I fall for someone, I want to give it my all. And then everything else falls apart! That's me! Not good at all...!
lines.133: Think about it! Do you really believe I'm someone who can balance work and love!?
lines.138: Heh. Naturally, that's impossible! And even more so for me!!
lines.142: Why are you both so proud of your weaknesses???
lines.151: In the first place. Aren't you all under a massive misunderstanding?
lines.155: I'm busy chasing my ideals right now! As the House of Swes, I will make trade between the Farlands and Palpebra flourish without fail...!
lines.159: Also! If I ever get time off, I want to hang out with you all more!!?
lines.163: I'm insanely jealous of you all going out to have fun!! Once I have time, I'm definitely joining in!
lines.172: Ahaha. Alk and Sho are so popular.
lines.177: What are you saying? I want to hang out with you too, Nova! From the bottom of my heart!
lines.181: Really? Then I guess I'm popular too?
lines.185: Ugh... What is this conversation... Isn't it kinda cringey...?
lines.189: You're laughing, Alk, but I want to move forward with you as a business partner too, you know?
lines.198: Investment! I haven't given up on investing in Starview Village, and by extension, all of you!
lines.202: Ah... Right. You did mention that...
lines.205: Purgers and the like are frightening, but I won't lose the friends I finally made!
lines.208: If you need funds, just say the word. Oh, don't worry. Money is one thing I have plenty of!
lines.216: There you go dodging it again! I'm serious--
lines.223: That's why I'll talk it over with Stella later. For sure.
lines.227: Heh heh heh... I see, I see! Ah, at last I can officially do business with this town!
lines.231: Doesn't he seem happier now than he's been all day?
lines.235: Of course! I can finally support you with my own weapon, you know?
lines.238: Listen up, everyone! From now on, I'll support you with everything I've got! In the name of Libram Swes!

3.title: The Man Moving Forward
3.summary: At a mixer for merchants of Palpebra and the Farlands, Libram strengthens the bonds between the two cities while discerning who he can trust. He also finally comes face to face with the brother who has been avoiding him. Though he still whines, with friends who laugh along with him to lean on, Libram keeps moving steadily forward.

lines.5: But the real key is the reconciliation faction. We must share what we know about the Purgers with the Farlands too, and warn them of this crisis.
lines.8: Suspicion and fear will be our greatest enemies. The role of keeping them from taking root-- May I entrust it to you?
lines.12: Even so, with you, I believe we can walk the right path.
lines.16: We'll join hands with the knightly houses and quell this chaos. And then uncover the truth. Lend me your strength, Swes.
lines.23: --I was working hard too, you know! In the Farlands! Really hard!!
lines.26: Reassuring the people of Swes who were anxious about Yuwel and the others! Helping with mountains of cleanup!!
lines.30: And yet! Everyone's so caught up in Prince Varen and Yuwel!! You could praise me too, couldn't you!
lines.34: I-it's not like nobody's praising you...? Yuwel and the others were really grateful too, you know?
lines.38: Well, you sure had plenty of guts, right? You didn't run even when we ran into monsters.
lines.42: H-heh heh. Exactly, exactly! Dul Kugala entrusted this to me, after all. I'm still working hard, I am!!
lines.46: Come to think of it, isn't that the outfit from White Fest? Is it for work...?
lines.50: Yes, there's a mixer for merchants tonight. Time to get back to what I should be doing.
lines.52: Sharing information with the Farlands' reconciliation faction so doubt and fear don't take hold-- While discerning who I can trust.
lines.55: Heavy responsibility and trust still make my legs shake, though.
lines.59: What? You still can't step up unless someone kicks your butt?
lines.67: Scary things are scary! If you seriously think I can charge ahead all on my own, I'm offended!!
lines.71: Just hurry up and do what you gotta do. If you trip, I'll laugh at you.
lines.76: ...Yes! Today, too, I'll do everything I can!
lines.82: Well, it's truly an honor to meet you. Your younger brother has been a great help to us.
lines.83: The Yuni you introduced to us the other day is selling well. We're even going to stock other sparkling wines next.
lines.86: Thank you kindly. I've been enjoying Palpebra's wines a lot lately. The sweetness of the grapes is so lively--
lines.90: I'm glad I held this party. It seems everyone's enjoying themselves.
lines.93: It's all thanks to the connections you made for us, Libram. "That matter" seems to be going smoothly too.
lines.96: --Valentine's Day and White Day. We want those customs to take root in the Farlands.
lines.99: We'd love to borrow the knowledge of everyone from Palpebra and Shibuya.
lines.102: This is a friend from Shibuya. They plan to open a sweets shop in Palpebra soon.
lines.104: Down the line, I'd love for them to expand into the Farlands too. Shibuya's sweets are wonderful as well.
lines.107: ...Honestly, this moves me. Forgive me, but I'd assumed the Farlands made a point of not adopting other countries' cultures...
lines.110: I can't say that's entirely untrue. It's a fact that many of our people take pride in our culture above all else.
lines.113: But there are also those who want to take in new things on top of that. Who want culture and business to evolve--
lines.117: Connecting those wishes is my job now. Feel free to rely on me anytime, all right?
lines.127: The Farlands will be lively next year, brother. I intend to move ahead with preparations right away.
lines.130: I've also found people we can talk to about the Purgers. I'll introduce you later.
lines.133: ...I've also decided which people of Swes will help with controlling information. Let's have everyone meet soon.
lines.138: ...We finally see each other, and yet we haven't had time to talk properly since the monster disaster, have we?
lines.143: Haha... Truly. Just us brothers-- I hope a time comes when the three of us can talk.
lines.152: He's stubbornly avoiding me. It seems certain he's still working behind the scenes.
lines.155: ...For now, sharing information with those of like mind comes first. Facing Ziggurat may have to wait a little longer.
lines.158: The right path really is a slow one. ...It's so frustrating.
lines.166: I believe in the path we want to walk. Because--!
lines.172: --See? We got to meet like this.
lines.175: It's been a while, brother Ziggurat.
lines.178: ...Why are you here? Did Azrail send you? Or--
lines.182: What else! To make peace, obviously!
lines.185: I gave it everything I had. I asked around using every connection I have, and I finally found you...!
lines.187: I have a mountain of questions, too! About the House of Kwetur, for one! Why you and brother Azrail--!
lines.190: Three brothers joining hands. Is that really so difficult...?
lines.193: ...Truly. Such weak, naive, wavering eyes. Why would you go this far...
lines.199: I will never accept Azrail's path. Nor do I have any expectations of an eldest son who grovels before other nations.
lines.201: I am the one who will bring the Farlands the greatest profit. I will prove it.
lines.204: We'll meet again, I'm sure of it. When our paths cross...!
lines.209: Huh, Libby? What're you standing around by yourself for?
lines.214: S-standing around!? I was desperately holding my ground!
lines.217: Honestly, my knees were about to shake the whole time! If anything, I'd like some praise!!
lines.223: Yes! Amazing and admirable! Well, I can't help feeling there was a bit more we could have talked about--
lines.225: Not everything has to succeed from the start. Just getting to talk is a step forward...! That's my way!
lines.228: No clue what you're on about, but if you're free, let's go drink. I wanna actually land someone tonight~.
lines.231: Again!? Would you stop trying to use my good looks alone!!?
lines.235: ...It's all right. Even if I fall flat on my face or mope around, I have friends who'll laugh it off with me--
lines.238: That alone is enough for me to keep moving forward...!

there's no way Libby could ever gracefully

5000340/3.19:
White Fest grew out of the other-world custom of White Day, brought to Palpebra by Drifters, and developed in its own way.
Efforts led by the House of Swes are underway to establish it in the Farlands alongside Valentine's Fest, and there are plans to bring in sweets shops as well.

5000390/3.19:
Even after the Farlands' monster disaster, Ziggurat has not changed his course one bit, and continues his activities while avoiding his brothers.

But his brothers' ideals are just as strong. "The day our paths cross again isn't far off"-- or so says the third son.

5000627/1.19:
A sparkling wine brewed from apples grown in the Farlands.

One of the specialties of the Oinas domain, it is known for having been backed in production by the late Princess Iseria.
It is gradually becoming more common in Palpebra as well, and is turning into a drink that symbolizes the friendship between the two cities.
